{"reason":"Replace the medium/high supplier switch with alert-planner. V1 has 34 switches and four stockouts at $2.165M; premium freight costs $35k versus $45k and always arrives. This saves $340k across the 34 switches and cannot increase stockouts, including fixing switch rows at inventory-days 5.3 and 2.8.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
